name: Chol'aruk the Ravener
summary: A horror stalks a cave on Thorn Hill in the Barrens, where the Razormane call it Chol'aruk the Ravener. Bainham seeks its severed head to avenge comrades lost to similar beasts.

sections.title: Terror of Thorn Hill
sections.body: Northwest of Bainham's camp in the Barrens, Thorn Hill rises above the Savannah. Razormane tribes have long fought over the plateau. Now rumors speak of a monstrous abomination in one of its caves, called Chol'aruk or the Ravener by the Razormane. Some travelers dismiss tales that it can swallow an armored orc whole. Those who have seen the carnage know the danger is real.

sections.title: A Grudge Repaid
sections.body: Bainham knows Chol'aruk is no campfire tale. He has fought similar horrors and bears scars from those encounters, while mourning comrades who fell to such beasts. He fears the abomination threatens everyone crossing the Savannah. Bainham asks seasoned champions to climb Thorn Hill, enter its underground lair, slay Chol'aruk, and bring back its massive head.

faq.q: What kind of creature is Chol'aruk?
faq.answer: Chol'aruk is a monstrous abomination in a cave on Thorn Hill. Rumors say it is large enough to swallow a grown orc whole, and the local Razormane call it the Ravener.
Chol'aruk lairs in a cave on the high plateau of Thorn Hill, northwest in the Barrens.

faq.q: Who is Bainham and why does he want Chol'aruk dead?
faq.answer: Bainham lives in the Barrens and has fought similar beasts. He wants Chol'aruk dead because he lost allies to such abominations and seeks vengeance for his fallen comrades.
The local Razormane quilboar call Chol'aruk the Ravener, a name tied to its ravenous nature. Rumors say it devours full-grown warriors whole.

faq.q: Do the Razormane quilboar worship or fear Chol'aruk?
faq.answer: Whether the Razormane quilboar fear or worship Chol'aruk is unknown. They call it Chol'aruk or the Ravener, but nothing more is known of their feelings toward the abomination in Thorn Hill's cave.

faq.q: What proof is required to confirm Chol'aruk's death?
faq.answer: Bainham asks you to bring back Chol'aruk's severed head as proof of its death.

angles.text: Unchecked monsters on the high plateaus threaten travelers and caravans crossing the Barrens. Slaying the beast would help protect the region.
As a hunter, tracking a predator rumored to swallow fully armored warriors whole tests your skill and nerve.
As a warrior, you can answer Bainham's call by facing a towering horror in its underground lair and avenging fallen comrades.
